ModMetaData.name: The Secret of Anima - Core
ModMetaData.author: Nuff
ModMetaData.description: The core mod for The Secret of Anima, a series of mods focused on providing an alternate progression path for your colony. Instead of technology, embrace the power of the Anima tree. This core mod primarily adds resources, buildings, and game mechanics for use by the other mods in the series.
